title: Mitsubishi Chemical Cleansui says GoQSystem order data of 10,466 people may have been exposed
date_note: Cleansui's second notice is dated 24 November; the intrusion at GoQSystem was 10 to 11 November, first notice 17 November.
geo_basis: The pages state no city for Cleansui; country only
summary: Mitsubishi Chemical Cleansui says a third party accessed the order management system of its vendor GoQSystem on 10 and 11 November, through what the notice calls a vulnerability in an inquiry form. Per GoQSystem's findings, 10,466 customers (purchasers and recipients) are affected; names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses and order details may have been exposed. Cleansui says GoQSystem holds no credit card data.
plain: A vendor's order system used by Cleansui's online shops was accessed by a third party. Cleansui says 10,466 customers are affected and personal details may have been exposed, but no card data.
exec: A vendor breach exposed order data of 10,466 customers of a brand's online shops, per Cleansui's notice.
action: Cleansui advises customers to be wary of suspicious emails, SMS or calls impersonating Cleansui, GoQSystem, shops or delivery firms, and not to click links or open attachments in them.

evidence.quote: 対象件数：ご注文 9,894件（楽天市場 7,152件、Yahoo!ショッピング 2,431件、au PAY マーケット 311件）／お客様 10,466名

validation.note: Cleansui's own notice read; Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays it. Same GoQSystem incident as goqsystem-order-system-unauthorized-access-2026-11, a different victim organisation.
